titulo: 10:09 a.m.: Five Below CEO pay vs. a median employee's year
caption:
10:09 a.m.: Five Below CEO pay vs. a median employee's year

On paper: reported CEO pay, spread over a 2,080-hour year, matches a median employee's whole year by 10:09 a.m.

Reported CEO total pay, fiscal 2025: $10,814,084. Median employee total pay, fiscal 2025: $5,982. Both from Five Below's proxy statement (DEF 14A), filed May 1, 2026. From a May 2026 filing.

The proxy says its median crew member is a part-time sales associate.

Name a company. We'll run its clock.

Our math: $10,814,084 spread over 2,080 hours is about $5,199 an hour, rounded down. $5,982 is reached at that rate in 1 h 9 min 2 s (the clock shows 10:09 a.m. from a 9:00 a.m. start; minutes are rounded down).

Sources
F1: Five Below proxy statement (DEF 14A), filed May 1, 2026 · https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1177609/000119312526199315/d86361ddef14a.htm
